import copy,fcntl,json,pickle,sys,traceback
from pathlib import Path
from experiments.decision_evidence_transfer import RankedOnline,ATTRIBUTED_METHOD,evidence_proposals
from legal_skill_guard.learning.experiment import ROOT,read,sha,now,points
from legal_skill_guard.learning.member_learning import paired_effect
from legal_skill_guard.experiment.storage import RunStore
from legal_skill_guard.utils.hashing import canonical_json_sha256 as csha

class VerdictFirstRepair(RankedOnline):
    def execute(self):
        assert self.cfg["method"]==ATTRIBUTED_METHOD and len(self.documents)==16
        reference=ROOT/self.cfg["reference_run"]
        terminal=read(ROOT/self.cfg["reference_terminal_preservation"])
        assert terminal["state"]=="terminal_results_preserved" and terminal["all_members_verified"]
        assert sha(terminal["archive"])==sha(terminal["rootdisk_copy"])==terminal["archive_sha256"]
        assert read(reference/"failure.json")["actual_new_native_teacher_calls"]==[18,1]
        parent=read(ROOT/self.cfg["parent_publication"])
        assert self.bank==parent["publication"] and len(self.bank)==16
        assert self.prefix_ids==[r["id"] for r in self.past] and len(self.prefix_ids)==202
        self.validate_runtime_bank()
        self.record("declaration.json",{"at":now(),"config":self.cfg,"frozen_bindings":self.bindings.copy(),
            "actual_latest_bank_not_selected":self.bank,"source_run_remains_failed":True,
            "complete_first8_known_training_sources_not_unseen_evaluation":[r["id"] for r in self.documents[:8]],
            "next8_forward_source_ids_not_taught":[r["id"] for r in self.documents[8:]],
            "planned_new_native_teacher_CPUfits":[40,1,0],
            "new_teacher_gets_exact_visible_candidate_observations":True,
            "original_210_model_reuse_not_new_fit":self.cfg["forward_ordinary_manifest"],
            "not_full128_independent_repeat_official_TEST_or_efficacy_gate":True})
        self.current_batch=1;self.phase="b1_prequential"
        for index,row in enumerate(self.documents[:8]):
            leads=evidence_proposals(self.prefix_model,row,self.labels)
            for arm in (("joint_empty","skills") if index%2==0 else ("skills","joint_empty")):
                self.joint(row,arm,leads)
        fresh=self.score(self.answers);self.units.extend(fresh)
        groups={a:[u for u in fresh if u["condition"]==a] for a in ("joint_empty","skills")}
        originals={a:[] for a in groups}
        for row in self.documents[:8]:
            for arm,stage in (("joint_empty","b1_prequential"),("skills","b1_after_seen")):
                old=read(reference/f"logical_answers/{stage}/{row['id']}/{arm}.json")
                assert old["ordinary_tool_source_ids"]==self.prefix_ids
                assert old["bank_sha256"]==csha(self.bank if arm=="skills" else [])
                originals[arm].append(old)
        oldgroups={a:self.score(v) for a,v in originals.items()}
        self.record("batch_summaries/b1_before.json",{"at":now(),
            "repaired_interface_actual_latest_bank_metrics":{a:points(v) for a,v in groups.items()},
            "source_first_reference_metrics":{a:points(v) for a,v in oldgroups.items()},
            "same_case_skill_effect":paired_effect(groups["joint_empty"],groups["skills"],seed=2026101941,replicates=5000),
            "interface_repair_effect_by_arm":{a:paired_effect(oldgroups[a],groups[a],seed=2026101942+i,replicates=5000) for i,a in enumerate(groups)},
            "ALL8_same202_tool_same_actual_R1_no_new_teacher_yet":True,
            "repairs_both_output_order_and_original_anchor_reading_policy_not_single_word_causal_claim":True,
            "known_training_sources_not_generalization":True})
        print(json.dumps({"all8_repaired_interface_before_new_teacher":{a:points(v) for a,v in groups.items()}}),flush=True)
        self.update_procedure_online(self.documents[:8])
        ordinary=read(ROOT/self.cfg["forward_ordinary_manifest"])
        assert sha(ordinary["path"])==ordinary["sha256"]
        assert ordinary["source_ids"]==[r["id"] for r in self.past+self.documents[:8]]
        with Path(ordinary["path"]).open("rb") as stream:self.prefix_model=pickle.load(stream)
        assert not self.prefix_model.programs
        assert set(self.prefix_model.corpus_.doc_ids)==set(str(d) for d in ordinary["source_ids"])
        self.prefix_ids=ordinary["source_ids"]
        self.record("ordinary_controls/reused_actual_after_B1_210.json",{"at":now(),"original":ordinary,"new_CPU_fit_count":0,
            "both_forward_arms_share_exact_model":True,"original_fit_cost_retained_in_reference_run":True})
        self.current_batch=2;self.phase="b2_prequential";start=len(self.answers)
        for index,row in enumerate(self.documents[8:]):
            leads=evidence_proposals(self.prefix_model,row,self.labels)
            for arm in (("joint_empty","skills") if index%2==0 else ("skills","joint_empty")):
                self.joint(row,arm,leads)
        forward=self.score(self.answers[start:]);self.units.extend(forward)
        fg={a:[u for u in forward if u["condition"]==a] for a in groups}
        summary={"at":now(),"batch":2,"prequential_metrics":{a:points(v) for a,v in fg.items()},
            "same_case_skill_effect":paired_effect(fg["joint_empty"],fg["skills"],seed=2026101945,replicates=5000),
            "all8_new_sources_all16_answers_before_Gold_scoring":True,"forward_only_no_update":True,
            "current_actual_library_sha256":csha(self.bank),"current_ordinary_source_ids":self.prefix_ids}
        self.record("batch_summaries/b2_before.json",summary)
        assert len(self.native)==40 and len(self.teachers)==1 and not self.fit_records
        result={"at":now(),"run_id":self.run_id,"actual_new_native_teacher_CPUfits":[40,1,0],
            "inherited_encoding_and_source_first_failure_costs":[21,1,1],
            "total_this_128_repair_family_native_teacher_CPUfits":[61,2,1],
            "same_case_interface_factorial_readout":read(self.out/"batch_summaries/b1_before.json"),
            "actual_corrective_skill_learning_effect":read(self.out/"update_effects/b1.json"),
            "forward8_summary":summary,"final_actual_bank":self.bank,"units":self.units,
            "all_adverse_original_scores_retained":True,
            "not_full128_algorithmic_repeat_or_official_TEST":True}
        self.record("completion.json",result)
        RunStore.atomic_json(self.out/"progress.json",{"at":now(),"state":"completed","run_id":self.run_id,
            "completed_native_calls":40,"completed_teacher_calls":1,"actual_new_CPUfits":0,
            "forward_metrics":summary["prequential_metrics"]})
        print(json.dumps({"completed":self.run_id,"forward_metrics":summary["prequential_metrics"]}),flush=True)

with (ROOT/"artifacts/gpu_generation.lock").open("a+") as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(),fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    study=VerdictFirstRepair(Path(sys.argv[1]))
    try:study.execute()
    except BaseException as error:
        failure={"at":now(),"state":"failed","error":repr(error),"traceback":traceback.format_exc(),
            "actual_new_native_teacher_calls":[len(study.native),len(study.teachers)],
            "no_retry_answer_repair_bank_selection_or_original_run_mutation":True}
        study.record("failure.json",failure);RunStore.atomic_json(study.out/"progress.json",failure);raise
